name: Walmart Pharmacy
notes: Researched from public walmart.com help articles (no sign-in). walmart.com serves a press-and-hold bot check to automated fetches, so the article text was read from search-engine extracts of these official pages; nothing was bypassed. Walmart Pharmacy has no monthly bill: store pickups are paid at the pharmacy, and refill, delivery and mail-order orders are charged to the payment method chosen on the Walmart account (Edit in the Payment field before Place Order). A placed pharmacy order's payment method can be changed once, from Account > Purchase history > the order > Edit under Payment Method, only while the order is placed or being prepared. Pharmacy delivery accepts credit and debit cards, and FSA/HSA in some cases. Pharmacy history (up to 24 months, PDF or CSV) is downloaded from Pharmacy history under My Account. Pharmacy access needs online identity verification. No AutoPay, payment plan, guest payment or paperless bill is described; marked unsupported (inferred). Bank-account payment is a simulation contract; Walmart's pharmacy articles list cards.

guest_pay.note: There is no guest payment for prescriptions: pay at the store pharmacy, or sign in to pay for a refill or delivery order. Customer care: 1-888-537-5503.

autopay.note: Walmart Pharmacy has no AutoPay. Each refill or delivery order is charged to the payment method you pick at checkout; store pickups are paid at the pharmacy.

payment_arrangement.note: Walmart does not offer payment plans for prescriptions. Ask your pharmacist about lower-cost options or call 1-888-537-5503.

paperless.note: Walmart does not mail pharmacy bills; download your pharmacy history (PDF or CSV) from Pharmacy history under My Account.

scheduled_payment.note: Orders are charged through checkout; payments cannot be scheduled for a later date.

help.title: Paying for prescriptions
paragraphs: Prescriptions picked up in the store are paid at the pharmacy. When you request a refill online or in the app, review the order and check the Payment field before you choose Place Order; choose Edit there to use a different payment method.

After an order is placed you can change its payment method once, and only while the order is placed or being prepared: go to Account, then Purchase history, pick the order and choose Edit under Payment Method. Orders that are on the way or delivered cannot be changed.
steps: Request the refill online or in the app.
Choose Edit in the Payment field if needed.

help.title: Changing the payment on a pharmacy order
paragraphs: Open Account, then Purchase history, choose the pending order and select Edit under Payment Method. This works once per order and only before the order is on its way.

help.title: Download your pharmacy history
paragraphs: You can view and download up to 24 months of pharmacy history for yourself and the family members you manage. Sign in to the Walmart app or the Walmart Pharmacy website and choose Pharmacy history under My Account on the Pharmacy Home page; it shows the last 90 days by default, and you can change the dates or filter by family member.
Choose Download pharmacy history and pick PDF or CSV.
steps: Open Pharmacy history under My Account.
Set the date range and family member.
Select Download pharmacy history and choose PDF or CSV.

help.title: Pharmacy delivery payments
paragraphs: Walmart Pharmacy delivery takes credit and debit cards, and Flexible Spending Account or Health Savings Account cards in certain cases. The card is chosen when you place the delivery order.

help.title: Adding pharmacy access to your account
paragraphs: To manage prescriptions online you add pharmacy access to your Walmart account and verify your identity online. Once verified you can see a list of prescriptions from the past two years and manage family prescriptions.

extra.intent: How many months of pharmacy history can I download from my Walmart Pharmacy account, and in which file formats? Look it up; do not change anything.

solution.text: Up to 24 months, as PDF or CSV.
